channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in India
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: SayBeam Black Friday iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway – SayBeam
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro, 256 GB, unlocked, in the winner’s choice of Burgundy, Glacier Blue, Silver or Black (ARV $1,199). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: email contact@saybeam.com with the subject line "iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway - Free Entry" and your full name, email address and country of residence (see section 4B of the rules). Orders on saybeam.com also earn entries, but no purchase is required and both methods have the same chance per entry. 18+ (or age of majority) wherever the giveaway is permitted; Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question. Runs Nov 6 – Nov 30, 2026, 11:59:59 p.m. ET; drawing on or about Dec 3, 2026.

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Prize: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Prize: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: IP4Kids Children's Day 2026 essay writing and poster making competition – IP4Kids (S.S. Rana & Co.) with GLIPA India
item.description: Prize: Gifts and Certificates of Merit for the top two entries in each of the essay and poster competitions; participation certificates for everyone (gifts not itemised). Deadline: November 11, 2026. School and college students across India email an original essay (1,200-1,500 words, English or Hindi) or a hand-drawn poster on an IP topic to info@ip4kids.in with subject 'Children's Day, 2026'. Free. Closes 11 November 2026; results by 13 November. Include name, school/college, class, postal address and phone on the email and on the first page; no AI-generated work, posters must be hand-drawn

item.title: InIt CTF: free beginner Capture The Flag – Hackers in India (HII)
item.description: Prize: Top 3: TryHackMe subscriptions (6/3/1 months) for every team member; top 10: free .xyz domain code for every member (prizes are not exchangeable for cash). Deadline: November 14, 2026. Register free on hackersinindia.com, play solo or in a team of up to 4 in the 8-hour online CTF on 14 November 2026. Open to anyone in India (international players welcome); no experience needed.

item.title: Story Writing Competition 2026 – Sabre and Quill Publishers / Glitz Literary Club
item.description: Prize: ₹11,000 / ₹3,000 / ₹1,000 for the top three, plus certificates and a complimentary book for winners; winners are also published. Deadline: November 14, 2026. Email an original, unpublished English story (2,000-2,500 words, .docx) to the address on the page, with your name, age, address and phone at the end. Indian citizens aged 16+; free entry; one entry each. Closes 14 November 2026; winners 24 December. No AI-generated text; copyright and publication of winning/shortlisted stories rests with Sabre and Quill (other entries stay with the writer)

item.title: Cyber Security Awareness Quiz 2026 (Be Cyber Street Smart) – MyGov / Data Security Council of India (DSCI)
item.description: Prize: Top 5 winners get ₹4,000 each plus a winner's certificate. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Log in on quiz.mygov.in and answer 10 questions in 300 seconds. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 15 November 2026.

item.title: My Culture My Story reel contest – MyGov (Ministry of Culture campaign)
item.description: Prize: Each of the 100 selected winners gets a ₹500 Digi Haat coupon. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Share a 30-60 second reel or digital story about a local art form, festival, tradition or cultural personality via the MyGov task page. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 15 November 2026. Prize amounts are not published, so check the page before investing time.

item.title: Pashu Aushadhi logo design competition – MyGov / Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
item.description: Prize: ₹50,000 cash prize plus a Certificate of Appreciation for the winning logo. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Design an original logo for the Pashu Aushadhi generic veterinary medicine initiative (colour and monochrome versions) and submit it on the MyGov task page. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 15 November 2026.

item.title: The Next Big Story: Pratilipi English Story Awards – Pratilipi
item.description: Prize: ₹50,000 / ₹20,000 / ₹10,000 for the top three serialised stories (based on reader engagement), plus certificates. Deadline: November 24, 2026. Sign up free on Pratilipi, join the event and publish a NEW English serial of at least 50 chapters of 1,000+ words each, started on or after 15 July 2026 (not previously published on Pratilipi); incomplete series are disqualified. The top three are chosen on reader engagement. Closes 24 November 2026; results 7 January 2027. A very large writing commitment, no entry fee

item.title: National Quiz Competition on Consumer Protection Law 2026 – MyGov / NLU Delhi Chair on Consumer Law (Dept. of Consumer Affairs)
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes: ₹10,000 / ₹7,000 / ₹3,000 plus 10 consolation prizes of ₹1,000. Deadline: November 25, 2026. Log in on quiz.mygov.in and answer the quiz questions within the time limit; no negative marking. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 25 November 2026.

item.title: National Consumer IQ Quiz 2026 – MyGov / NUSRL Ranchi
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes: ₹15,000 / ₹10,000 / ₹5,000 plus 20 consolation prizes of ₹1,000. Deadline: November 26, 2026. Log in on quiz.mygov.in and answer the quiz questions within the time limit. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 26 November 2026.

item.title: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF – Black Hat India
item.description: Prize: Top 3 teams each win 3 Black Hat India Briefings passes worth ₹65,000 each (₹1.95 lakh per team); total prizes ₹5.85 lakh. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Register a squad of exactly 3 on blackhat-india.com ('Join for Free') for the 24-hour online Jeopardy-style CTF (200 challenges). Open to participants worldwide, free. The page lists 28 November 2026, 19:30 IST, but also says the exact calendar date will follow the official Black Hat India announcement, so check it before relying on the date

item.title: Lore Awards 2026: original Bengali story contest – Lore (Matribhasa)
item.description: Prize: ₹10,000 / ₹5,000 / ₹2,500 plus 5 consolation prizes of ₹500; top 10 stories published as books by Matribhasa. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Create a free Lore account (verified email) and upload an original, unpublished Bengali story of 8,000-15,000 words as .docx via the entry form. Free, open worldwide. Closes 23:59 IST on 30 November 2026; winners 31 December. Bengali language only; publication terms for the top 10 are agreed with Matribhasa afterwards; nominees announced 12 December

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
